name: Medebach (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Medebach (quartered with a fleur-de-lis, a black cross and a key, inscribed MEDEBACH).
history: Municipal flag of Medebach; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Medebach arms — quartered with fleur-de-lis, cross and key, inscribed MEDEBACH
